axons.name: Axons
axons.tagline: Open-source Next.js boilerplate, the foundation of this site
axons.context: Axons is a reusable foundation for building multilingual, search-friendly Next.js websites and web applications. This site, ezjsdev, derives from it: it only adds its identity, pages and content, and takes everything else from Axons.
axons.role: Author: design, development and maintenance of the project.
contribution: Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19, in TypeScript
Six languages with translated URLs, hreflang tags, an XML sitemap and structured data
Markdown articles and collections, with server-side code highlighting
Material UI components isolated behind a neutral API, light and dark themes
Extension points to derive a site without modifying the foundation
Unit and end-to-end tests, Storybook, continuous integration and deployment on Netlify

idealco.name: Idealco
idealco.context: Redesign of the idealco.fr website in Next.js 14+, from 2023 to 2025, after a first collaboration with Idealco in 2021-2022.
